title: 1 Battalion pre-embarkation parade, shipboard scenes, arrival in Korea DPR/S/10 · 권리:PD(저작권 만료)
summary: At a 1 RAR parade held in Japan on 28 March 1952, the Commander in Chief British Commonwealth Force Korea, 36 (VX38969) Lieutenant General William Bridgeford took the general salute. After inspecting the parade he took the salute at the Battalion march past.
